q: 妈妈___厨房做饭。
zh: 妈妈在厨房做饭。
en: Mom is cooking in the kitchen.
why: 在 + place sets where the action happens and stands before 做饭. 跟 and 给 need a person, and 从 marks a starting point, not the location of an activity.
py: mā mā zài chú fáng zuò fàn

q: 我周末___爷爷奶奶一起吃饭。
zh: 我周末跟爷爷奶奶一起吃饭。
en: I eat with my grandparents at the weekend.
why: A companion in a shared activity takes 跟 before the verb, and 一起 follows it. 给 would make the grandparents recipients, and 在 needs a place, not people.
py: wǒ zhōu mò gēn yé yé nǎi nǎi yì qǐ chī fàn

q: 我们___超市门口等你。
zh: 我们在超市门口等你。
en: We'll wait for you at the supermarket entrance.
why: The place where the waiting happens takes 在 before 等. 往 and 从 describe movement toward or away from a place, and 离 measures distance, none of which fits standing still.
py: wǒ men zài chāo shì mén kǒu děng nǐ

q: 姐姐昨天___商场买了一条裙子。
zh: 姐姐昨天在商场买了一条裙子。
en: My older sister bought a skirt at the mall yesterday.
why: The mall is where the buying took place, so 在商场 stands before 买. 给 would name who the skirt was for, and 跟 or 对 need a person, not a place.
py: jiě jiě zuó tiān zài shāng chǎng mǎi le yī tiáo qún zi

q: 周末我常常___女朋友的父母一起在家包饺子。
zh: 周末我常常跟女朋友的父母一起在家包饺子。
en: At weekends I often make dumplings at home together with my girlfriend's parents.
why: 一起 signals a shared activity, so the partner is introduced by 跟 before the verb. 给 and 对 aim the action at a person instead of doing it together, and 向 means toward.
py: zhōu mò wǒ cháng cháng gēn nǚ péng yǒu de fù mǔ yì qǐ zài jiā bāo jiǎo zi

q: 昨天晚上我___给妈妈打电话，她有点生气。
zh: 昨天晚上我没给妈妈打电话，她有点生气。
en: I didn't call Mom last night, and she was a bit upset.
why: 昨天 makes it a past event that did not happen, so 没 goes before the coverb phrase 给妈妈. 不 is for habit or will, and 别 is a command.
py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng wǒ méi gěi mā mā dǎ diàn huà tā yǒu diǎn shēng qì

q: 我家离地铁站___远，走路五分钟。
zh: 我家离地铁站不远，走路五分钟。
en: My home is not far from the subway station; it's a five-minute walk.
why: 远 is an adjective predicate, so 不 goes directly in front of it, after 离地铁站. 很 and 太 would say it is far, which clashes with five minutes on foot.
py: wǒ jiā lí dì tiě zhàn bù yuǎn zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng

q: 我对做饭___感兴趣，所以天天点外卖。
zh: 我对做饭不感兴趣，所以天天点外卖。
en: I'm not interested in cooking, so I order takeaway every day.
why: 对做饭 comes first, then 不 goes right before 感兴趣. 很, 也 and 都 cannot give a reason for ordering takeaway every day.
py: wǒ duì zuò fàn bù gǎn xìng qù suǒ yǐ tiān tiān diǎn wài mài

q: 姐姐对我很好，哥哥___对我很好。
zh: 姐姐对我很好，哥哥也对我很好。
en: My older sister is very good to me, and my older brother is also very good to me.
why: 也 adds a second person to the same statement and sits before the coverb 对我. 都 needs a plural subject, and 才 and 又 do not mean also.
py: jiě jiě duì wǒ hěn hǎo gē gē yě duì wǒ hěn hǎo

q: 爸爸、妈妈和我___在阳台上喝茶。
zh: 爸爸、妈妈和我都在阳台上喝茶。
en: Dad, Mom and I are all having tea on the balcony.
why: 都 sums up the three people and, like every adverb, comes before the coverb 在阳台上. 也 would mean someone else already does it, which the cue does not say.
py: bà bà mā mā hé wǒ dōu zài yáng tái shàng hē chá

q: 这件衣服的价钱跟那件___一样，那件便宜一些。
zh: 这件衣服的价钱跟那件不一样，那件便宜一些。
en: This coat's price isn't the same as that one's; that one is a bit cheaper.
why: 一样 is a state predicate, so 不 goes right before it, after 跟那件. 也, 都 and 很 would claim the prices match, which contradicts 那件便宜一些.
py: zhè jiàn yī fú de jià qián gēn nà jiàn bù yí yàng nà jiàn pián yi yī xiē

q: 我昨天___在网上给妈妈买生日礼物，因为忘了密码。
zh: 我昨天没在网上给妈妈买生日礼物，因为忘了密码。
en: I didn't buy Mom's birthday present online yesterday, because I forgot the password.
why: A past event that did not happen takes 没 before the first coverb, 在网上. 不 would express habit or intention, and 还 (still) does not fit forgetting the password.
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi zài wǎng shàng gěi mā mā mǎi shēng rì lǐ wù yīn wèi wàng le mì mǎ

q: 我家___超市很近，走路只要三分钟。
zh: 我家离超市很近，走路只要三分钟。
en: My home is close to the supermarket; it takes only three minutes on foot.
why: The gap between two fixed places is 离 + place + 很近. 从 needs a movement or a start, 往 needs a direction verb, and 在 would mean located at.
py: wǒ jiā lí chāo shì hěn jìn zǒu lù zhǐ yào sān fēn zhōng

q: 爸爸___早上七点工作到晚上六点。
zh: 爸爸从早上七点工作到晚上六点。
en: Dad works from seven in the morning until six in the evening.
why: 从 marks the start of a time span and 到 its end. 离 measures a gap and takes 远, 近 or 还有, and 在 does not pair with 到 here.
py: bà bà cóng zǎo shàng qī diǎn gōng zuò dào wǎn shàng liù diǎn

q: ___春节还有两个星期，妈妈已经开始买年货了。
zh: 离春节还有两个星期，妈妈已经开始买年货了。
en: There are still two weeks until Spring Festival, and Mom has already started buying New Year goods.
why: A time gap to a coming event is 离 + event + 还有 + time. 从 marks a starting point and would be followed by 开始 or 到, not 还有.
py: lí chūn jié hái yǒu liǎng gè xīng qī mā mā yǐ jīng kāi shǐ mǎi nián huò le

q: 从这家商场___我家要坐二十分钟公交车。
zh: 从这家商场到我家要坐二十分钟公交车。
en: From this mall to my home it takes twenty minutes by bus.
why: 从…到… frames a route with a start and an end, and 要 + time gives the duration. 离 cannot follow 从 or pair with it.
py: cóng zhè jiā shāng chǎng dào wǒ jiā yào zuò èr shí fēn zhōng gōng jiāo chē

q: 这家超市___我家有两公里，走路太远了。
zh: 这家超市离我家有两公里，走路太远了。
en: This supermarket is two kilometres from my home, too far to walk.
why: Two fixed places plus 有 + distance is the 离 pattern. 从 needs a movement or a time start, and 往 and 向 need a direction verb.
py: zhè jiā chāo shì lí wǒ jiā yǒu liǎng gōng lǐ zǒu lù tài yuǎn le

q: 我女儿___下个月开始学钢琴。
zh: 我女儿从下个月开始学钢琴。
en: My daughter will start learning the piano from next month.
why: 从 + time + 开始 marks when something begins. 离 would need 还有 or 远, and 往 and 向 are directions, not times.
py: wǒ nǚ ér cóng xià gè yuè kāi shǐ xué gāng qín

q: 银行___我们小区不远，但是___我们小区到银行要过两条马路。
zh: 银行离我们小区不远，但是从我们小区到银行要过两条马路。
en: The bank isn't far from our neighbourhood, but you have to cross two roads to get from the neighbourhood to the bank.
why: The first clause gives a gap, so 离 + 不远. The second traces a route with a start and an end, so 从…到. Swapping them gives 银行从…不远 or 离…到, neither of which exists.
py: yín háng lí wǒ men xiǎo qū bù yuǎn dàn shì cóng wǒ men xiǎo qū dào yín háng yào guò liǎng tiáo mǎ lù

q: 现在___孩子放学还有一个小时，我先去超市买点菜。
zh: 现在离孩子放学还有一个小时，我先去超市买点菜。
en: There's still an hour until the kids finish school, so I'll go buy some groceries first.
why: 离 + event + 还有 + time counts the gap before a future event. 从 would mark a starting point and cannot be followed by 还有, and 往 and 为 do not mark time.
py: xiàn zài lí hái zi fàng xué hái yǒu yí gè xiǎo shí wǒ xiān qù chāo shì mǎi diǎn cài

q: 爷爷___我们都很好，常常给我们买零食。
zh: 爷爷对我们都很好，常常给我们买零食。
en: Grandpa is good to all of us and often buys us snacks.
why: Kindness toward someone is an attitude, so it takes 对 + person + 好. 给 marks the recipient of a thing, and 向 and 往 are directions.
py: yé yé duì wǒ men dōu hěn hǎo cháng cháng gěi wǒ men mǎi líng shí

q: 我想___你商量一下周末的安排。
zh: 我想跟你商量一下周末的安排。
en: I'd like to discuss the weekend plans with you.
why: 商量 is mutual: two people talk it over, so the partner takes 跟. 对 and 给 aim the action one way, and 为 would mean for your sake.
py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ shāng liáng yī xià zhōu mò de ān pái

q: 妈妈每天晚上都___我打电话。
zh: 妈妈每天晚上都给我打电话。
en: Mom calls me every evening.
why: The person who receives a call takes 给 before 打电话. 跟 is for a partner in a mutual act, 对 for an attitude, and 向 for facing or learning from someone.
py: mā mā měi tiān wǎn shàng dōu gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà

q: 这个孩子___画画很感兴趣。
zh: 这个孩子对画画很感兴趣。
en: This child is very interested in drawing.
why: 感兴趣 always attaches to its topic with 对. 跟 is for a partner, 给 for a recipient, and 向 would face a person.
py: zhè ge hái zi duì huà huà hěn gǎn xìng qù

q: 小李下个月要___女朋友结婚。
zh: 小李下个月要跟女朋友结婚。
en: Xiao Li is getting married to his girlfriend next month.
why: 结婚 is mutual, so the other person is introduced with 跟 before the verb. 对 and 给 point one way, and 往 needs a direction.
py: xiǎo lǐ xià gè yuè yào gēn nǚ péng yǒu jié hūn

q: 我想___你们介绍一下我的新同事。
zh: 我想给你们介绍一下我的新同事。
en: I'd like to introduce my new colleague to you.
why: 介绍 hands something to people, so the audience takes 给 before the verb. 跟 would make you introduce him together with them, and 对 fits attitudes, not introductions.
py: wǒ xiǎng gěi nǐ men jiè shào yī xià wǒ de xīn tóng shì

q: 隔壁的奶奶___我们的小狗很友好。
zh: 隔壁的奶奶对我们的小狗很友好。
en: The old lady next door is very friendly to our puppy.
why: 友好 describes an attitude toward someone, so 对 + target + 友好. 给 needs a thing handed over, and 向 and 往 need a direction.
py: gé bì de nǎi nǎi duì wǒ men de xiǎo gǒu hěn yǒu hǎo

q: 我昨天___店老板谈了价格，他同意便宜一点儿。
zh: 我昨天跟店老板谈了价格，他同意便宜一点儿。
en: I negotiated the price with the shop owner yesterday, and he agreed to lower it a bit.
why: Bargaining is two-sided, so the shop owner is a partner introduced with 跟. 给 would make him the recipient of the talk, and 对 is for attitudes.
py: wǒ zuó tiān gēn diàn lǎo bǎn tán le jià gé tā tóng yì pián yi yì diǎn ér

q: 这位售货员___顾客非常热情，所以大家都爱来这家店买东西。
zh: 这位售货员对顾客非常热情，所以大家都爱来这家店买东西。
en: This salesperson is very warm to customers, so everyone likes to shop at this store.
why: 热情 describes an attitude toward people, so 对 + customers. 跟 would present customers as partners in a joint activity, and 给 needs something handed over.
py: zhè wèi shòu huò yuán duì gù kè fēi cháng rè qíng suǒ yǐ dà jiā dōu ài lái zhè jiā diàn mǎi dōng xī

q: 我想___奶奶买一件羽绒服，冬天她的腿总是冷。
zh: 我想给奶奶买一件羽绒服，冬天她的腿总是冷。
en: I want to buy a down jacket for Grandma; her legs are always cold in winter.
why: The person who benefits from the buying takes 给 before 买. 跟 would make Grandma a shopping partner, and 对 fits attitudes, not purchases.
py: wǒ xiǎng gěi nǎi nǎi mǎi yī jiàn yǔ róng fú dōng tiān tā de tuǐ zǒng shì lěng

q: 我要___爷爷学习做饭，他做的菜最好吃。
zh: 我要向爷爷学习做饭，他做的菜最好吃。
en: I want to learn cooking from Grandpa; his dishes are the tastiest.
why: 向 + person + 学习 means learn from someone. 往 needs a direction and a movement verb, 朝 means facing, and 给 would mean doing it for him.
py: wǒ yào xiàng yé yé xué xí zuò fàn tā zuò de cài zuì hǎo chī

q: 弟弟做错了事，主动___妈妈道歉。
zh: 弟弟做错了事，主动向妈妈道歉。
en: My younger brother did something wrong and apologised to Mom on his own initiative.
why: 道歉 is abstract and directed at a person, which 向 can introduce. 往 needs a place or direction, and 为 would mean apologising on someone else behalf.
py: dì di zuò cuò liǎo shì zhǔ dòng xiàng mā mā dào qiàn

q: 你___前走五分钟，就能看到那家商店。
zh: 你往前走五分钟，就能看到那家商店。
en: Walk straight ahead for five minutes and you'll see that shop.
why: 往 + direction + movement verb is the basic pattern for directions. 从 marks a starting point, 离 a gap, and 给 needs a recipient.
py: nǐ wǎng qián zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng jiù néng kàn dào nà jiā shāng diàn

q: 他___我笑了笑，什么也没说。
zh: 他朝我笑了笑，什么也没说。
en: He gave me a smile and said nothing.
why: 朝 can face a person, as in 朝我笑. 往 needs a direction or place, so 往我笑 is impossible, and 在 would mean he smiled at some location.
py: tā cháo wǒ xiào le xiào shén me yě méi shuō

q: 出了超市，___东走一百米就是我家的小区。
zh: 出了超市，往东走一百米就是我家的小区。
en: After leaving the supermarket, walk a hundred metres east and my neighbourhood is right there.
why: A compass direction plus a movement verb takes 往. 对, 为 and 给 mark targets or beneficiaries, not directions.
py: chū le chāo shì wǎng dōng zǒu yì bǎi mǐ jiù shì wǒ jiā de xiǎo qū

q: 听说你要当妈妈了，我真___你高兴。
zh: 听说你要当妈妈了，我真为你高兴。
en: I heard you're going to be a mom, and I'm really happy for you.
why: Feeling happy on someone account takes 为. 对 would aim the feeling at the person like an attitude, and 跟 is for a partner in an act.
py: tīng shuō nǐ yào dāng mā mā le wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng

q: 妈妈今天不舒服，不能去开家长会，我___她去。
zh: 妈妈今天不舒服，不能去开家长会，我替她去。
en: Mom isn't feeling well and can't go to the parents' meeting, so I'm going in her place.
why: Going instead of someone who cannot go is 替. 对, 往 and 从 do not express substitution.
py: mā mā jīn tiān bù shū fú bù néng qù kāi jiā zhǎng huì wǒ tì tā qù

q: 别___我担心，我一个人在家没问题。
zh: 别为我担心，我一个人在家没问题。
en: Don't worry about me; I'm fine at home on my own.
why: Worrying about someone is 为 + person + 担心. 对, 跟 and 往 cannot introduce the person you worry about.
py: bié wèi wǒ dān xīn wǒ yí gè rén zài jiā méi wèn tí

q: 哥哥考上了大学，全家人都___他骄傲。
zh: 哥哥考上了大学，全家人都为他骄傲。
en: My older brother got into university, and the whole family is proud of him.
why: Pride on someone account takes 为 before the feeling word. 对, 往 and 跟 are not feeling markers.
py: gē gē kǎo shàng le dà xué quán jiā rén dōu wèi tā jiāo ào

q: 售货员热情地___大家服务，所以这家店的生意特别好。
zh: 售货员热情地为大家服务，所以这家店的生意特别好。
en: The sales staff serve everyone warmly, so business at this shop is especially good.
why: 服务 is done for people, and 为 + people + 服务 is the set pattern. 往, 跟 and 从 mark direction, partnership or origin, none of which fits.
py: shòu huò yuán rè qíng dì wèi dà jiā fú wù suǒ yǐ zhè jiā diàn de shēng yì tè bié hǎo

q: 你回家以后，请___我向奶奶问好。
zh: 你回家以后，请替我向奶奶问好。
en: When you get home, please say hello to Grandma for me.
why: Doing something for someone in their place is 替 + person: 替我向奶奶问好 is the set courtesy. 对, 往 and 从 do not mean on my behalf.
py: nǐ huí jiā yǐ hòu qǐng tì wǒ xiàng nǎi nǎi wèn hǎo

q: 弟弟还不会___筷子吃饭，只会用勺子。
zh: 弟弟还不会用筷子吃饭，只会用勺子。
en: My younger brother can't eat with chopsticks yet; he only uses a spoon.
why: A tool for doing something is introduced with 用 before the verb. 坐 is for vehicles you sit in, 骑 for bikes, and 给 for recipients.
py: dì di hái bú huì yòng kuài zi chī fàn zhǐ huì yòng sháo zi

q: 妈妈每天___公交车去超市。
zh: 妈妈每天坐公交车去超市。
en: Mom takes the bus to the supermarket every day.
why: Travelling by bus uses 坐, placed before 去. 骑 is for bikes and horses, and 开 means driving it yourself.
py: mā mā měi tiān zuò gōng jiāo chē qù chāo shì

q: 哥哥喜欢___自行车去商店买东西。
zh: 哥哥喜欢骑自行车去商店买东西。
en: My older brother likes to ride his bike to the shops.
why: Bicycles are straddled, so the verb is 骑. 坐 is for seated transport like buses, 开 is for driving, and 拿 means to hold.
py: gē gē xǐ huān qí zì xíng chē qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xī

q: 妈妈___手机给爸爸转了一千块钱。
zh: 妈妈用手机给爸爸转了一千块钱。
en: Mom transferred a thousand yuan to Dad with her phone.
why: The means of doing something comes first with 用 + tool. 坐 is for vehicles, 往 for direction, and 对 for attitude.
py: mā mā yòng shǒu jī gěi bà bà zhuǎn le yī qiān kuài qián

q: 我们家离学校太远了，我每天___校车上学。
zh: 我们家离学校太远了，我每天坐校车上学。
en: My home is too far from school, so I take the school bus every day.
why: A school bus is a vehicle you ride in, so 坐 + 校车 comes before 上学. 骑 is for bikes, 开 is for the driver, and 用 would treat the bus as a tool.
py: wǒ men jiā lí xué xiào tài yuǎn le wǒ měi tiān zuò xiào chē shàng xué

q: 下班以后，爸爸总是___地铁回家，因为晚上开车太堵了。
zh: 下班以后，爸爸总是坐地铁回家，因为晚上开车太堵了。
en: After work Dad always takes the subway home, because driving is too congested at night.
why: Going home by subway is 坐地铁 before 回家. 开 is for driving a car, 骑 for bikes, and 用 would treat the subway as a tool.
py: xià bān yǐ hòu bà bà zǒng shì zuò dì tiě huí jiā yīn wèi wǎn shàng kāi chē tài dǔ le

q: 我们___这把旧钥匙打开了奶奶家的门，发现屋里一个人也没有。
zh: 我们用这把旧钥匙打开了奶奶家的门，发现屋里一个人也没有。
en: We opened Grandma's door with this old key and found nobody inside.
why: 用 + tool + verb: the key is the instrument. 对, 往 and 朝 aim at a person or direction and cannot express the means.
py: wǒ men yòng zhè bǎ jiù yào shi dǎ kāi le nǎi nǎi jiā de mén fā xiàn wū lǐ yí gè rén yě méi yǒu

q: 我想把这个包裹寄___我妈妈。
zh: 我想把这个包裹寄给我妈妈。
